codes.code: October is especially valuable for collectors and event players. Prioritize World Space Week for Astronaut Pikachu, Zorua Community Day for Candy and Shiny hunting, and Halloween 2026 Part One for spooky encounters, event research, and possible limited-time reward drops. Keep checking the in-game event calendar and the Pokémon GO Web Store for new Timed Research, promo codes, and partner rewards.
